en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ya`qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Mu`awiya b. Wahb from Mu`adh b. Muslim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
Be patient with those who oppose blessing, for there is no better way to deal with those who disobey Allah than to obey Allah.
